story_note: Phil returns to the daily puzzle with his usual morning ritual, noticing the new challenge immediately.
continuation_note: Tomorrow, Phil plans a return visit to the Sapiver Press Suite for fresh puzzles and familiar comfort.

scenes.title: Back Again
scenes.beat: Return after yesterday, new daily puzzle, same habit
scenes.dialogue: Another day, another puzzle to solve.
scenes.caption: Phil settles in with his tea and crossword.
scenes.screen_state: Phil seated with puzzle visible on screen.

scenes.title: Different Start
scenes.beat: The first move shows today's puzzle is different
scenes.caption: The puzzle begins differently from yesterday.
scenes.screen_state: Close-up of puzzle grid beginning clues.

scenes.title: The Pushback
scenes.beat: A fair stuck moment, no guessing
scenes.dialogue: No shortcuts. I need to think this through.
scenes.caption: Phil faces a thoughtful pause, no guesses yet.
scenes.screen_state: Phil looking pensive, hand on chin.

scenes.title: The Column
scenes.caption: A logical breakthrough opens new paths.
scenes.screen_state: Puzzle grid shows a column with several answers filled.

scenes.title: The Follow-Through
scenes.caption: Pieces begin falling into place one by one.
scenes.screen_state: Puzzle grid with more completed answers.

scenes.title: Worth Returning For
scenes.beat: Completion or honest latest progress, return tomorrow
scenes.dialogue: Not done yet, but I'll be back tomorrow.
scenes.caption: Progress made and anticipation for a return visit.
scenes.screen_state: Phil closing the puzzle with a smile.

style_rules: No masthead inside individual scene art.
Sapiver Press logo/title only on merchandise and monitor/browser URL.
Story text must continue from previous episode, not repeat a fixed template.
Puzzle screen must be composited from real capture, not invented by image generation.
The scene should be comic illustration, not photorealism.
